subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should `openclaw agent --message-file` adopt the documented 4 MiB hard limit for all currently supported file-like inputs?
rationale: The implementation and terminal proof make a bounded read plausible, but choosing a permanent maximum for an existing unbounded CLI input is an upgrade-policy decision that cannot be settled from the supplied evidence alone.

options.title: Confirm the 4 MiB input contract
options.body: Accept the documented ceiling after final-head source and CI verification confirms that FIFO, symlink, and procfs paths retain their supported semantics.

options.title: Use a different compatibility policy
options.body: Request a different bound or an opt-in resource-control design if existing automation may legitimately require messages over 4 MiB.

recommendation.title: Confirm the 4 MiB input contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented ceiling after final-head source and CI verification confirms that FIFO, symlink, and procfs paths retain their supported semantics.
